## Ownership map

Files that move to another module. A path ending with `/` is a directory; the longest matching entry wins. Files of a module without an entry stay in that module; hub files without an entry stay in the hub. `hypothesis` means the owning phase confirms or changes the entry when it reads the code.

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `scripts/ecosystem-units.py` | scripts (hub root) | aicore | unit | P12 | hypothesis | becomes the aicore unit check |
